fusions.name: Gnawing Updraft
fusions.desc: Sends a gnawing gust into the first enemy it meets, dealing 7 damage and healing you for 15% of the damage dealt. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Stripped Fields
fusions.desc: Sweeps a devouring cloud on the wind across a cone 6 tiles ahead, dealing 28 damage plus 4% of a boss's or elite's maximum health to everything in it. Each hit has a 50% chance to leave the target [Enervated] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Swarm at Your Back
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 25% for 15 seconds. For 10 seconds, a swarm rides the wind beside you, striking for 3 every 1 second.

fusions.name: Picked Clean
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict something, 15% of the damage you deal heals you for 6 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
